hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.css|*.json) case "$f" in */src/*) npx --no-install prettier --write "$f" ;; esac ;; *.rs) case "$f" in */src-tauri/*) cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- "$f" ;; esac ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
